import_schedule.title: Import or replace schedule
import_schedule.description: Paste Southwest pairing-detail text (Herb, Local, or Domicile Time) or compact local-time roster rows.

clear_schedule.title: Remove a schedule
clear_schedule.description: Remove the selected schedule from Pilot Tracker without affecting other loaded schedules.

reset_aircraft.title: Resolve an aircraft change
reset_aircraft.description: Release the aircraft currently associated with this leg and safely run candidate validation again. Use this only after confirming an actual aircraft swap.

complete_current_leg.title: Manually complete current leg
complete_current_leg.description: Mark the active leg complete and open the next leg. Use this only after confirming arrival when automatic FR24 evidence is missing.

error.invalid_schedule: The text is not a supported Southwest pairing or local-time roster.
error.schedule_conflict: This schedule conflicts with the active trip or current leg and was not applied.
error.no_current_leg: There is no current leg to reset.
error.no_active_leg: There is no actively tracked leg to complete.
error.schedule_horizon: The loaded schedules would span more than 62 days. Remove older schedules first.
error.active_trip_tracking: A schedule cannot be removed while its current leg is actively tracked.
